summary: The only supported shell on z/OS UNIX is the z/OS Shell at /bin/sh, set with the ansible_shell_executable inventory variable.
questions: Which shell should Ansible use on z/OS UNIX?
How do I set the remote shell for a z/OS host?
Can I use bash on z/OS with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Configuring the remote shell on z/OS
answer_card.answer_md:
z/OS UNIX has several shells, but only the z/OS Shell at `/bin/sh` is supported. Set it with `ansible_shell_executable`:

```ini
zos1 ansible_shell_executable=/bin/sh
```
